adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and updates `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` to loop over each destination and call `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)`. However, `Office365CalendarService.createEvent` still derives the target calendar from only the first element (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` then posts to `/me/calendars/${mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId}/events`), with no selection by the credential being used. This can mis-target calendar IDs when iterating over multiple hosts/credentials (same “pick first destinationCalendar” pattern is also present in the Lark service and the CalDAV base service filter). Separately, `CalendarManager.createEvent` now calls `calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)` and swallows failures into `success = false` with logging, matching the finding’s described failure mode.
